title: It holds all of my spices OK, but there aren't enough supports.
text: It holds all of my spices OK, but there aren't enough supports.. Although I assembled and adjusted it for all of my spices, I had to prop it up halfway between the two upper shelf supports. It would be really great if it had three or four supports for the upper shelf, instead of two.

product_metadata.title: Allstar Innovations Spice Spinner Three-Tiered Spice Organizer & Holder That Saves Space, Keeps Everything Neat, Organized & Within Reach With Dual Spin Turntables Grey- 3 Tier
features: DUAL SPIN LAZY SUSAN – Built-in turntables keep all your spices at your fingertips with a simple spin. Makes everything visible and provides storage for taller items. Reclaim unused space in your cabinets and keep everything in view!

D SHAPED DESIGN – Turn any mess into a customized masterpiece! Uniquely constructed to save space by fitting flush against any cabinet or cupboard to hold up to 56 spices and condiments. Spins to bring spices closer to you.

ADJUSTABLE HEIGHTS – Use your Spice Spinne with 3 Tiers or 2, you can customize the storage capacity of your pantry, cabinet or fridge as well as adjust to fit your cabinet. Allows you to easily store smaller and larger spices and more! Three levels ensure maximum storage.

USE IT ANYWHERE IN YOUR HOME – Stack cans and bottles in your fridge, reclaim your bathroom counter space and organize your medications and toiletries, or make craft tables neat and always ready for creative minds.
SAVES SPACE – Depth 10.75”, width 13” to fit most cabinets and cupboards
